ExcludedEntry.description: A directory the scan listed but did not enter because of an exclude.

path.description: Its absolute path, as lossy UTF-8.

ObjectQuery.description: What a one-object verb was asked.

path.description: The path it was asked about, absolute.

device_confined.description: Whether the scan stayed on the root's filesystem (`-x`).

error_count.description:
Directories that could not be read, and entries listed but not
read.

excluded.description: Each directory the excludes kept the scan out of, path bytewise.

excluded_count.description:
Files left out and directories not entered by the excludes
(`--exclude`, `--exclude-from`, `--ignore-from`, `--exclude-caches`).

fs_type.description:
The root volume's filesystem type; null when the scan recorded no
volume.

id.description: The saved scan's id; null for a scan that was not saved.

incremental.description: Whether the scan reused an earlier one (never before phase 5).

root.description: The root, absolute, symbolic links resolved.

root_as_given.description: The root as the command line gave it.

size_kind.description:
The size the rows are ranked and shown by: `allocated` or
`apparent`.

total_allocated_bytes.description: Bytes on disk, hard links and clones counted once.

total_apparent_bytes.description: Apparent bytes, hard links counted once.

vanished_count.description: Entries that disappeared during the scan.

volumes.description: Every volume the scan met, entered or not.

Summary.description:
`summary`'s answer: a scan's totals under a path, each volume's share,
and how the scan ran.

allocated_bytes.description: Bytes on disk, hard links and clones counted once.

dataless_bytes.description:
The logical size of the dataless files (iCloud and other
placeholders), which the allocated bytes leave out.

du_compatible_bytes.description: Bytes on disk as `du` counts them: hard links once, clones each.

error_count.description: Directories and entries the scan could not read.

incremental.description: Whether the scan updated an earlier one.

parent_scan_id.description: The scan it updated; null for a full scan.

vanished_count.description:
Entries that disappeared during the scan: the whole scan's, since
the index does not place them under a path.

volumes.description: The volumes the scan met under the path.

allocated_bytes.description: Bytes on disk the scan found on it under the path.

free_bytes.description: Its free space, at the scan's start; null where unknown.

reason.description: Why not, when it did not.

total_bytes.description: Its size, at the scan's start; null where unknown.

Tool.description: The program that wrote an envelope.

free_bytes.description: Bytes an unprivileged user can still write.

reason.description: Why not (`one_file_system`, `network`, …); null when it did.

code.description: One of the conventions' warning codes.

count.description: How many things it is about, where that applies.

hint.description: One imperative sentence naming a command.

description:
What a verb that answers with one object (`explain`, `summary`,
`query`; `schema` to come) prints under `--json`: the shared fields, the
scan it read (null when none was), and the object as `result`. `query`
says what it was asked in a block of its own.

next.description: Up to three runnable commands, most useful first.

scan.description: The saved scan the answer comes from; null when none holds the path.

schema_version.description: The version of the envelope's shape.

title: ObjectEnvelope
